rows.en: ＊Eiji＊＠０５３＿００１Yo! Headin' back? Let's walk￥together for a bit.＝＠０５３＿００２Hey, hey! You know that Kairi￥guy, one of the candidates,￥right?
＊Eiji＊＠０５３＿００３He's gotta be THE Kairi, the￥famous one, right?＝＠０５３＿００４Guess when you're picking people￥to go to Elan, you get famous￥folks like him too.
＊Eiji＊＠０５３＿００６He's the youngest ever to win￥that whatchamacallit￥biology prize.
＊Eiji＊＠０５３＿００７Whaaat? Seriously, you don't￥know? He's super famous!
＊Eiji＊＠０５３＿００８He was the youngest ever to win￥that whatchamacallit￥biology prize.
＊Eiji＊＠０５３＿００９I heard the news shows even did￥specials on him...＝＠０５３＿０１０And that magazine,￥"Science Future"...
＊Eiji＊＠０５３＿０１２Yo! Kairi! We were just talkin'￥about you.＝＠０５３＿０１３You were on the cover of￥"Science Future" a while back,￥weren't you?
＊Eiji＊＠０５３＿０１５What kind of answer is that?￥We're talking about you!
＊Eiji＊＠０５３＿０１７Forget it, you killed my buzz.￥See ya...

＊Kairi＊＠０５３＿０２１I did win the Norst Biology￥Prize, but whether that makes me￥well known, I couldn't say...＝＠０５３＿０２２I think I may have been on a￥magazine cover too... but it's￥not something I care about.
＊Kairi＊＠０５３＿０２４I did win the Norst Biology￥Prize, but whether that makes me￥well known, I couldn't say.
＊Kairi＊＠０５３＿０２５That guy said something too, but￥I've never cared about that.
＊Kairi＊＠０５３＿０２６Same as when I got the prize...￥I wasn't aiming for anything.＝＠０５３＿０２７I was just looking into what￥interested me, and by chance it￥led me to a new bacterium.
＊Kairi＊＠０５３＿０２８When I discover something,￥I want to find out exactly￥what it is.＝＠０５３＿０２９How others use the results is￥no concern of mine. My interest￥is in the findings alone.
＊Kairi＊＠０５３＿０３２Whether the world recognizes me￥or not makes little difference.
＊Kairi＊＠０５４＿００１People are happiest when they're￥absorbed in what interests them.￥Isn't that obvious?
＊Kairi＊＠０５４＿００２So, do you still need something?￥If not, move.＝＠０５４＿００３You're in my way.
＊Kairi＊＠０５４＿００５The way I said it? I just said￥it normally.＝＠０５４＿００６Anyway, you're in my way...￥Move.
＊Kairi＊＠０５４＿００７I need to get to the Archives.￥There's data I want to copy...
